stem: Which statement is best represented by the graph of the function?

options.label: A
options.text: The equation of the asymptote of the graph is \( x = 4 \).

options.label: B
options.text: The function is increasing on the interval \( x > 0 \) and decreasing on the interval \( x < 0 \).

options.label: C
options.text: The x-intercept of the graph of the function is \( (8, 0) \).

options.label: D
options.text: The y-intercept of the graph of the function is \( (0, 3) \).

visual_elements: graph of an exponential function with vertical asymptote at x=0, decreasing from y=13 at x=-1 down to near y=0 as x approaches positive 4.
notes: Options preserved with visible math; asymptote is vertical line x=0, none of the options states this correctly.
